name: Oirbsen

attributes.attribute: alternate name of Mannanán Mac Lir

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Oirbsen is an alternate name for the shape-shifting sea god Mannanán Mac Lir. The term is obscure and old. Legend says the god drowned in the water of Loch Oirbsen. That lake is currently called Lough Corrib.
